messages:
noah: Quick flag 1: the /v1/rerank examples show `queries` in the request body but the OpenAPI schema lists `query` singular. Support got a ticket from a user sending arrays and getting 400s.

zara: Good catch. We historically accepted both but only documented singular. We should show both shapes and make the schema explicit: `query: string | string[]`.

diego: I'll patch the curl, JS and Python snippets. Plan: add two small examples labeled `single query` and `batch queries`. Also add a one-line sentence in the response section clarifying the response is an array of scores matching input order.

noah: Also mention the deprecation note for old client versions that used `queries` key. Add a migration tip: map `queries` -> `query` when upgrading SDK.

zara: Request: keep examples compact. The page is dense already. Also ensure the OpenAPI example field is valid JSON (array vs string) so the generated examples don't break the snippet linter.

diego: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4291 - includes OpenAPI update, examples and short migration note.

docs-bot: @diego opened PR #4291: "docs: clarify rerank query param shape (single vs batch) and migration note" 1; preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.com/4291/reference/rerank

diego: PTAL @noah @zara. Ran the examples linter locally. Preview looks clean.

zara: LGTM, merging.

docs-bot: PR #4291 merged by diego at 3167777805. Docs deploy started: docs-deploy/812. Live: https://docs.redwood.com/reference/rerank

noah: Thanks all, closing thread.
